family: citation chasing on B03, B04, B06
rationale: Cheapest open family, and the one most likely to REFUTE: the composite claim is the conjunction of what these three separately establish, so a combining work would cite them.

acceptance_rule.REFUTED: a citing work implements the conjunction
acceptance_rule.FAMILY_CLOSED: forward citations of all three examined at title-and-abstract level, none implementing the conjunction
acceptance_rule.FAMILY_PARTIAL: citations examined for some records only

does_not_upgrade_composite_claim: Three other families remain open; the r01 rule requires all five.
refutation_requires_method_level: A candidate that appears to implement the conjunction is promoted to method level before being treated as a refutation.
declared_limit: Forward-citation coverage depends on what the indexes return. Closing means the reachable citations were screened, not that no citing work exists.
